post.description:
Valida un CURP de 18 caracteres y devuelve los datos oficiales del titular.

Por default opera de forma **asincrona** — la respuesta inmediata trae un `request_id` y el resultado final llega via webhook o se obtiene con `GET /dashboard/request/{request_id}`. Para esperar el resultado en la misma respuesta, pasa `sync: true` en el body (timeout interno 15s).

Cobra el precio de `validateCurp` (ver `/organization/tools-catalog`) cuando la consulta se ejecuta. Si el formato del CURP es invalido (validacion local), no se cobra.

201.description: Async (default): trae `request_id` para hacer polling o esperar webhook. Sync (`sync: true`): trae el resultado final.

data.description: Objeto vacío ({}) en async hasta que el webhook completa.

request_id.description: LogRequest id. Poll /status or wait for webhook.

status.description: Always "processing" — final state delivered via webhook.

outcome.description: Listanominal validation outcome. INE verdicts: vigente / dada_de_baja / no_encontrada / duplicada_o_robada / datos_no_coinciden. Pre-flight gate skips: unsupported_model / missing_fields / bad_field_format / low_confidence / inconsistent_data (no Bright Data spend on these). maintenance = INE site temporarily unavailable — billed because OCR + validations did run; client should retry later. scraping_error is an infrastructure failure (not billed).

baja_reason.description: Specific cause when outcome is `dada_de_baja`. Maps to the official INE FAQ catalog of removal reasons. null when the response page did not surface a reason. Undefined for other outcomes.

submit_group.description: Submit group on the listanominal form (C/D/E).

duration_ms.description: End-to-end Bright Data round-trip duration. Null when gate-rejected.

ine_model.description: Inferred credential model. Models A/B are legacy IFE (not validatable). C/D are 2008-2014. E/F/G/H are 2014+. "unknown" → OCR too ambiguous to classify.

checks.description: Internal validation checks (CURP format, MRZ check digits, etc).

listanominal.description: Listanominal step — null only when the worker never reached this stage.
